label: Pinion Smart.Shift
description: Shows the current gear and battery level of a Pinion Smart.Shift gearbox as Karoo data fields, with a low-battery alert at 20, 10 and 5 %. Unofficial: not affiliated with Pinion or Hammerhead. Built on Tim Angus's reverse engineering of the Smart.Shift Bluetooth protocol.
releaseNotes: Karoo can now show this extension's details and offer updates. Uses less Karoo battery while the gearbox cannot be found: after 2 minutes the search drops to a low-power mode.
